id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|312: It's a book called "Noah's Great Deeds."
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|316: Noah, the genius informant... Anyone who has lived in the underworld has heard that name.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|323: From your neighbor's secrets to the state secrets a minister hides, they say there is no information he cannot find.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|331: Where do his sources come from? Many rogues tried to find out, but nothing is known.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|33f: Rumor has it that just after birth he pointed to the sky and foretold a storm... A truly mysterious man.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|35b: It's a picture book called "The Rainbow Lantern."
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|35e: One warm, sunny day, the rainbow in the sky felt sleepy and let out a big yawn.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|366: And what do you know? The rainbow's tears split into seven lights, and from them a blue lantern boy was born.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|370: A flame acorn wearing a green leaf. A neon jellyfish with a pale blue flame. A yellow-bodied carnival light...
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|37c: ...Then came the red light. Jealous of the other colors, the red light ate the orange and the purple lights.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|38a: Ever since, the red light has had horns on its head, and wanders hell forever as a funeral fire.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|3a1: It's a biography called "The Formidable Merchant Rotondo."
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|3a6: Once a small port, Gondolia grew at dizzying speed in just a few decades into a great trading city.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|3b6: Mayor Rotondo built a trading city in a single lifetime. His secret to success was only one thing: not fearing failure.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|3c6: Since youth, he never stopped his ships for a single day, even when cargo sank in storms or plague struck aboard.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|3d8: The splendid sea routes that support Gondolia today would not exist without Rotondo's efforts.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|3ef: It's a book called "The Seafarer's Creed."
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|3f4: Any man standing on Gondolian soil should keep polishing himself into a seafarer who is not ashamed before the sea.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|402: That is: manly as rough waves, refreshing as the sea breeze, and generous as the ocean. Such a man is a true seafarer.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|40f: The Seafarer Contest is a sacred, men-only festival that chooses those worthy of the title.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|419: Young men who aspire to be seafarers, do not dishonor your name or the sea. -- First champion, Rotondo
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|436: It's a book called "The Diary of Blacksmith Ittetsu."
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|43b: ~Chapter 2: Following Dreams~ I'm Ittetsu the blacksmith, age 48. My favorite saying: fall seven times, get up eight.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|449: At the port town of Gondolia I entered the Seafarer Contest and, well, won. I found a lead on making mini medals.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|458: Apparently there's a school for mini medals in a valley region across the sea.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|460: They say it teaches everything about mini medals. Surely it will teach that delicate star craft too.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|46d: It's laughable for an old guy like me to study, but age doesn't matter when chasing a dream. That's how I've lived.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|47b: Watch me, Mother. I'll become the world's best blacksmith and return home again...
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|497: "This town was so lively, and now it's gotten lonely, hasn't it? Is this the Dark One's doing too? Well then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|4a6: "Doesn't look like there's anything here. If there are towns we haven't visited, exploring those wouldn't be bad. Well then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|4b7: "Since {var:1} defeated Jacolla, this port town has regained a little of its usual life.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|4c7: "Boss! Perfect sailing weather! Thanks to you beating the Dark One! Let's sail the open sea!
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|4db: "Eek! The town is full of monsters! We'd better wipe them all out at once, or we'll be retrying forever.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|4ea: "What'll it be, {var:1}? Shall we set sail?
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|4f3: "Understood, aye aye! Then I'll pray for {var:1} and everyone's victory from right here!
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|51a: It feels like a strange presence, like the roots of the Great Tree... but it has already withered.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|527: You sense a strange power from this sapling... but nothing seems to happen.
id./param/region/r007.pack|book_ie.bxon|541: You sense a strange power from this sapling... but nothing seems to happen.

tm.港町ダーハルーネで 海の男コンテストに出場し\nちょっくら優勝した 俺は\nちい: At the port town of Gondolia I entered the Seafarer Contest and, well, won. I found a lead on making mini medals.
tm.どうやら 海の向こうの渓谷地帯に\nちいさなメダルの学校とやらが あるらしい。: Apparently there's a school for mini medals in a valley region across the sea.
tm.その学校では ちいさなメダルのすべてを\n教えていると聞く。きっと\nあの精巧な: They say it teaches everything about mini medals. Surely it will teach that delicate star craft too.
tm.俺みたいな おっさんが 勉強なんて笑っちまうが\n夢を追うのに 年齢なんて 関係: It's laughable for an old guy like me to study, but age doesn't matter when chasing a dream. That's how I've lived.
tm.見ててくれよな おっかさん。\n世界一の鍛冶職人になって\nまた 故郷へ帰るさ…: Watch me, Mother. I'll become the world's best blacksmith and return home again...
tm.「あんなに にぎわってた この町も\n ずいぶんと さびしくなっちまったでげす。: "This town was so lively, and now it's gotten lonely, hasn't it? Is this the Dark One's doing too? Well then...
tm.「ここには 何もアリそうにないでがす。\n もし まだ訪れてない町があれば\n: "Doesn't look like there's anything here. If there are towns we haven't visited, exploring those wouldn't be bad. Well then...
tm.「{var:1}のダンナが ジャコラを倒したから\n この港町も ほんのすこしだ: "Since {var:1} defeated Jacolla, this port town has regained a little of its usual life.
tm.「アニキ！ 絶好の船日和でがすよ！\n これも アニキが 魔王を倒したおかげでが: "Boss! Perfect sailing weather! Thanks to you beating the Dark One! Let's sail the open sea!
tm.「はわわ～！ 町が魔物で いっぱいでげす！\n こりゃあ 一気に 魔物たちを全滅: "Eek! The town is full of monsters! We'd better wipe them all out at once, or we'll be retrying forever.
tm.「どうするでげす {var:1}さん？\n 船を 出航させるでげすか？: "What'll it be, {var:1}? Shall we set sail?
tm.「がってん承知の つかまつりでげす！\n それじゃ あっしは {var:1}さん: "Understood, aye aye! Then I'll pray for {var:1} and everyone's victory from right here!
tm.大樹の根と似た 不思議な気配を感じる。\n……だが もう 枯れてしまっているよう: It feels like a strange presence, like the roots of the Great Tree... but it has already withered.
tm.この苗木からは 不思議なチカラを感じる。\n……だが 何も起こらないようだ。: You sense a strange power from this sapling... but nothing seems to happen.
tm.苗木に 手をかざしますか？: Hold your hand over the sapling?
tm.老人に 人魚の思い出の歌を教わった！\n海底王国ムウレアの 宮殿前にいる\n歌が: An old man taught you the mermaids' memory song! Sing it to the song-loving mermaid at Nautica's palace!
